hook_pattern.description: First ~60s poses the audience's biggest/most unsettling question, promises a payoff by video's end (per user-supplied rule set K1); persona doc gives the opening hook block itself as ~30s, with the loop closed again in the closing segment (same hook question answered at the end). Refined 2026-08-08 by an independent 50-madde deep-dive source: the sharp question itself lands in a 30-45s band before pivoting to context (schema's duration_s field caps at 30 - the true band exceeds that ceiling by up to 15s, recorded here rather than in the field itself since the schema wasn't changed for this). The channel's own internal format label, confirmed verbatim across the new source: 'Format A: Keşif (Discovery)', counterpart 'Format B: Boutique Intellectual' - explains the pre-existing narrator_persona.shared_with reference to TPL-boutique-intellectual in templates/TPL-mystery-discovery.json, which was previously an unexplained cross-reference.

disclaimer: Structural/format analysis only. No content reproduction.
notes: Not run through Module 21's own Gemini pipeline (gemini_key_pool disabled this session, as noted in CFP-0001) - this profile instead formalizes the user's OWN prior structural analysis of the channel, supplied as 3 Word documents (18 scripting rules K1-K18, 5 music rules K19-K23, a shared narrator persona, and a hybrid-format strategy matrix), cross-checked against a WebSearch confirming the channel is real and topically matches (ancient history / mystery / metaphysics documentary content, ~10 years running). Confidence is higher than CFP-0001 because the source is the user's own close analysis, not secondhand web text - but cut_frequency_per_min and narration_pace_wpm are still estimates inferred from qualitative descriptors ('hızlı, merak uyandırıcı, kesik' pacing; conversational narration speed), not frame-counted, and should be treated as approximate. Key structural rules NOT captured by this schema's fields (recorded in full in templates/TPL-mystery-discovery.json's narrator_persona/content_rules blocks, not here, since Module 21 is structural-metrics-only per its own §2 boundary): the 18-beat scripting arc (hook -> academic grounding -> conflict framing -> 'hidden truth' motif -> etymology -> present-day anchor -> 'safe exit' framing -> puzzle-piece closing CTA), and 5 music rules (no vocals ever, low-frequency drone bed, cinematic suspense swells timed to reveals, neoclassical/orchestral for historical passages, music synced to narrator's breath/pauses). Format role in the user's hybrid model: 'Keşif' (Discovery) - fast-cadence, curiosity-driven, algorithm-facing; publishes ~3x/month; feeds the channel's second format (see CFP-0003) via an explicit end-of-video bridge line. UPDATE 2026-08-08: a new, independently-produced 50-madde (10-bölüm) structural deep-dive was supplied (archived at reports/source_docs/gercegi_bul_50madde/) that substantially corroborates rather than contradicts the above - same 'Sessiz Rehber' persona, same K19-K23-equivalent music rules, same K1-K18-equivalent scripting arc - raising confidence from 0.7 to 0.8 for the narrative/persona/audio dimensions specifically (cut_frequency_per_min and narration_pace_wpm remain qualitative estimates, not frame-counted, and did not get a confidence bump on their own). New concrete detail beyond the prior source: visual palette is specifically gold/dark-brown/black with recurring sandstorm and massive-stone-structure imagery (refined in templates/TPL-mystery-discovery.json's visual.palette); music references 'Scott Buckley tarzı' independently (matches existing K22, raising confidence in that specific rule); new rules K1a (no channel-intro boilerplate, direct 00:01 entry) and K18a (explicit closing bridge to Format B) added to the template; a new negative/forbidden rule was also added ('Format A'nın en büyük tuzağı' - unfounded claims with no traceable source, e.g. alien-visitation claims - are named by the channel's own analysis as its biggest trap to avoid). Editorially, the new source SHARPENS the conspiracy-adjacent characterization already on record: it names the doubt-engine as the format's literal driving mechanism (not incidental style), targets specific real institutions (CIA, Vatican, Smithsonian) with 'lab-rat' suspicion framing, and documents a deliberately-engineered 'trauma management' layer (music/tone softens, 'safe exit' lines deployed) after nihilist-adjacent claims - this reinforces, not revises, the pre-existing K4/K9-exclusion decision on any hybrid template built from this profile (see templates/TPL-baskurtlar-hybrid.json, TPL-ryskulov-hybrid.json).
